node.title: Conductor-256 character-diagonal exponent router
node.closure: finite-group Fourier diagonalization and exact exponent bounds
node.statement: The full conductor-256 circular-unit log map is a cyclic convolution on (Z/256Z)^x/{+-1}. Its 63 nontrivial character eigenvalues are explicit and nonzero. The fixed-cofactor E1 AM-GM body therefore gives certified Fourier, Euclidean, coordinate, and weighted-ellipsoid bounds on the unique integer exponent vector, reducing every associate family to a finite exact sparse-multiplication search.
node.notes: ANALYTIC SEARCH COMPILER 2026-07-29: extends the 63 basis exponents to one zero-sum 64-vector and diagonalizes by the characters of the cyclic group generated by 5. Nonvanishing follows from full log-lattice rank, not floating point. The packet prints a complete finite exponent region but no orbit count; exact inverse-pair coefficient and profile multiplication tests remain mandatory. No E1 or Prize status movement.
